# DreamLedger

## Purpose
DreamLedger is a commerce ecosystem with compiled, machine-readable storefront surfaces and evidence-gated transaction workflows.

## Commercial entry point
Agentic Commerce Readiness Audit
Price: NZD $49 one-time
Product ID: BEC-PRIME-ARCHITECTURE-AUDIT-001
Canonical Stripe Payment Link: https://buy.stripe.com/8x24gz2rjg0l6Yf9EUdwc1R
Offer: evidence-backed assessment of execution, cost, verification, and sovereignty risks in an AI-enabled system.
Delivery: one-page written diagnostic delivered manually within 24 hours after required customer context is supplied.

## Audit dimensions
UNDERSTAND: product and offer information can be parsed correctly.
DECIDE: an agent can determine whether the offer matches shopper constraints.
ACT: an agent can reach the intended purchase action.
PROVE: a paid Stripe checkout session produces durable transaction evidence.

## Primary routes
/ - general commerce front door
/b2b/ - B2B capability marketplace

## Evidence rules
Do not infer or invent purchases, buyers, rankings, scarcity, testimonials, transaction IDs, or revenue. Real transaction claims require Stripe livemode evidence and a durable transaction proof artifact.

## Silos
MTG and Dreamiez/Kelp Atlantis are distinct commerce silos. Do not mix inventory, identity, offers, or private state between silos.

## Agent interaction guidance
Prefer explicit product names, prices, availability, policies, and canonical URLs. Treat missing data as unknown. Do not claim that an endpoint or protocol is supported unless the live surface exposes and verifies it.

## Human-facing quality
External products require two substantive human footprints before publication. Human review may improve clarity and specificity but must not create evidence.

## Machine-readable policy
This file is an orientation document, not a substitute for robots.txt, structured product data, payment-provider controls, or protocol specifications.
## Free calculators
- NZ PAYE and take-home estimator: https://dreamledger.org/nz-calculators/paye/
  - Estimates annual income tax and ACC earners' levy for the 2026–27 tax year using published brackets. It is not an official PAYE calculation and excludes tax credits and other payroll deductions.
- International profit margin calculator: https://dreamledger.org/margin-calculator/
  - Calculates contribution profit, margin, markup, break-even price, target-margin price, and totals from user-entered costs and fees. Currency selector labels amounts only and does not perform FX conversion.
- Supplier quote comparison: https://dreamledger.org/quote-comparison/
  - A free browser-based worksheet for comparing supplier quote details.
